sentences.text: Also heard Mr.Sudhir Sharma, learned counsel holding  the brief of Mr.Sanjay Agrawal, learned counsel for respondent No.1 and Mr.Pawan Kesharwani, learned counsel for respondent No.2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the proceeding under Section 498A IPC was also initiated against the petitioners and Pranay Tripathi, who is husband of respondent No.1 and they are not aware of status of the said proceeding.
List this matter again in the next week in order to enable learned counsel for the petitioners to inform the status of said proceeding.

Sd/-
